description: kb ambient surfaces. UserPromptSubmit (kb-pull): score-floored hints naming what the KB holds about this prompt + the rolling session digest. Stop (kb-scribe): on a producing turn, block the yield until the session distills it into the digest and graduates durable items — active only in projects that keep a curated memory. SessionStart (kb-session-start): archive the previous sitting's digest so 'now' stays honest, and cue an unseeded project once. All fail-open; none blocks a tool call.
